gold: Let f(x) = x on the interval (-pi, pi], viewed as a square-integrable function on the circle mathbb{R} / 2pimathbb{Z}. Integration by parts gives its Fourier coefficients c_n; for n neq 0 the boundary term contributes c_n = frac{(-1)^n}{2pi i n} cdot 2pi, whose squared modulus is lvert c_n rvert^2 = 1/n^2, while c_0 = 0 because f is odd. Hence the identity lvert c_0 rvert^2 = 1/0^2 = 0 makes lvert c_nrvert^2 = 1/n^2 hold for every integer n. Parseval's identity states sum_{n in mathbb{Z}} lvert c_n rvert^2 = frac{1}{2pi} int_{-pi}^{pi} lvert f(x) rvert^2 , dx. The right-hand side is frac{1}{2pi} int_{-pi}^{pi} x^2 , dx = frac{1}{2pi} cdot frac{2pi^3}{3} = frac{pi^2}{3}. The left-hand side is sum_{n in mathbb{Z}} frac{1}{n^2} = 2 sum_{n geq 1} frac{1}{n^2} because the summand is even and the n = 0 term vanishes. Equating the two sides gives 2 sum_{n geq 1} frac{1}{n^2} = frac{pi^2}{3}, hence sum_{n geq 1} frac{1}{n^2} = frac{pi^2}{6}, the value asserted by the Basel problem .

      F34, F35, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
      F36 (by positivity : (0:ℝ) < 2 * π)]
    have hd : ‖(-2 * (π : ℂ) * I * (n : ℂ))‖ = 2 * π * |(n : ℝ)| := by
      simp [F36 F7]
    rw [hd, show 1 / (2 * π * |(n : ℝ)|) * (2 * π) = 1 / |(n : ℝ)| by field_simp,
      F37, F38, F39]

theorem F40 : F1 := by
  have hL2 : F41 (fun x : ℝ ↦ (x : ℂ)) 2 (F42 (F43 (-π) π)) := by
    refine F44 Complex.continuous_ofReal.aestronglyMeasurable π ?_
    rw [F45 F46]
    filter_upwards with x hx
    rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    exact F47 ⟨by linarith [hx.1], hx.2⟩
  have hint : ∫ x in (-π)..π, ‖(x : ℂ)‖ ^ 2 = 2 * π ^ 3 / 3 := by
    simp_rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, F39]
    rw [F48]; ring
  have hsum : F49 (fun n : ℕ ↦ (1 : ℝ) / (n : ℝ) ^ 2) :=
    F50 F51
  have hp := F52 F5 hL2
  simp_rw [F17] at hp
  rw [hint, F53] at hp
  have F54 : ∑' (i : ℤ), (1 : ℝ) / (i : ℝ) ^ 2 = 2 * ∑' (n : ℕ), (1 : ℝ) / (n : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
    rw [F55 (f := fun i : ℤ ↦ (1 : ℝ) / (i : ℝ) ^ 2)
        (hsum.congr fun n ↦ by push_cast; ring) (hsum.congr fun n ↦ by push_cast; ring)]
    push_cast
    simp F19 [F56]
    rw [show (1 : ℝ) / (0 : ℝ) ^ 2 = 0 by norm_num]
    ring
  F57 ∑' n : ℕ, (1 : ℝ) / (n : ℝ) ^ 2 = π ^ 2 / 6
  have h2S := F58 hp
  rw [show (π - -π)⁻¹ * (2 * π ^ 3 / 3) = π ^ 2 / 3 by field_simp; ring] at h2S
  linarith [h2S]

end F1
stmt: The Basel problem asserts the value of the convergent series sum_{n geq 1} frac{1}{n^2} = frac{pi^2}{6}. The summand at n = 0 is 1 / 0 = 0 by convention.
